role_definition: Inferred from absent key, null-valued lifecycle group, active index-tie group, remaining version-recency group, and within-key query cutoff rank. Producer role maps and witnesses never read.

audit_probe_scope.lower_version_append_invariance: One existing winner per row protected; original indices preserved.
audit_probe_scope.other_key_edit_invariance: First query protected only; own-key history untouched.
audit_probe_scope.future_event_edit_invariance: One query cutoff per row protected; strictly future same-key events modified; all indices fixed.
audit_probe_scope.query_key_counterfactual: Absent query key replaced by eligible other key at same cutoff.
audit_probe_scope.counts: Audit probes do not add any families or supplied records.

limitations: 768 correlated renderings are 12 source families / 48 controlled histories, not 768 independent memory mechanisms.
Rank normalization retains event order; near-isomorphic shuffled templates may therefore be undercounted. Cross-split motifs are exposed, not sealed structural OOD.
Absent queries all have never-used keys; future-only absence is not supplied.
All supplied queries independent; no query result changes another query. No persistent learned-memory, associative retrieval, source trust, unresolved-conflict or efficacy claim.
Reviewers share underlying model; separate actual executions do not make model errors independent.
